from rag_ingest import health, load_documents, ingest_documents, IngestError
import json, copy

# 1. Host surface unbroken
print('health():', health())
assert health() == 'ok'

# 2. Load documents still works (need a fixture file)
import tempfile, os
tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.json', delete=False)
json.dump({'documents': [{'doc_id': 'x', 'text': 'body'}]}, tmp)
tmp.close()
docs = load_documents(tmp.name)
print('load_documents:', docs)
os.unlink(tmp.name)

# 3. Determinism and no mutation
r = {'documents': [{'doc_id': 'p-s', 'text': '---\na: 1\n---\nS.'}]}
snapshot = copy.deepcopy(r)
res1 = ingest_documents(copy.deepcopy(snapshot))
res2 = ingest_documents(copy.deepcopy(snapshot))
assert res1 == res2, 'Not deterministic'
assert r == snapshot, 'Input mutated'
print('Determinism + no mutation: OK')

# 4. JSON-safe roundtrip
rec = ingest_documents({'documents': [{'doc_id': 't1', 'text': '---\nwhen: 2026-01-15\ncount: 3\nscore: 4.5\nok: true\ntags:\n  - a\n  - b\n---\nB.'}]})['records'][0]
json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False)
print('JSON roundtrip: OK')
print('metadata:', rec['metadata'])
assert rec['metadata']['when'] == '2026-01-15'
assert isinstance(rec['metadata']['when'], str)

# 5. Nested structures
rec2 = ingest_documents({'documents': [{'doc_id': 't2', 'text': '---\nouter:\n  inner:\n    x: 1\n    y: 2.5\n    z: true\n---\nBody.'}]})['records'][0]
print('Nested metadata:', rec2['metadata'])
assert rec2['metadata']['outer']['inner']['x'] == 1
assert rec2['metadata']['outer']['inner']['y'] == 2.5
assert rec2['metadata']['outer']['inner']['z'] is True

# 6. Input guard still works (host responsibility)
try:
    ingest_documents({'documents': [{'doc_id': 'g', 'text': None}]})
    print('ERROR: should have raised')
except IngestError as e:
    print(f'Input guard: {e.code} (expected INVALID_DOCUMENT_INPUT)')
    assert e.code == 'INVALID_DOCUMENT_INPUT'
